title: Port complete file classification, bundle identity and companion byte preservation
scope: Complete source classification and file bundle/companion byte functions over an owned ingress file set with stable local identity; preserve duplicate identities, first-model/fallback and retained associations across calls. No decoder/drop traversal or engine session state.
acceptance: Independent fixed original/Rust traces compare selection identity, all association state and ordered complete names/bytes, including repeated bundles and duplicates.
Bounded fallible owned data with explicit host limits and atomic association replacement; no dependency or product integration claim.
open_items: Specify and capture source cases before porting; native/Wasm runtime evidence pending.
